entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to start a return for an order I placed a while back.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Karen. I can definitely help you with that. Could I please get your full name and order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloGlide shoes. It looks like those were delivered about 51 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. I'd like to return them.
Okay, **no problem** at all. You're well within our **90 days** return window, so we can get this processed for you right away.
Oh, wonderful! I wasn't sure if it had been too long. That's great news.

Not at all. I'm sending the prepaid **return label** to the email on your account right now. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase as a thank you.
Wow, that's very generous. Thank you so much, Karen. You've made this incredibly easy.
It's my pleasure, Alex! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again for your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer, and have a fantastic day!
